senses.gloss: to require or force someone to do something because of a rule, duty, or situation

translations.th_TH: ต้องการ; เพื่อบังคับ

definition_translations.zh_TW: 因規則、責任或情況要求或迫使某人做某事
definition_translations.ja_JP: 規則、義務、状況により人に何かを求める、または強いること
definition_translations.ko_KR: 규칙, 의무, 상황 때문에 누군가에게 무언가를 요구하거나 강요하는 것

senses.gloss: to do something helpful for someone
senses.example: The hotel staff was happy to oblige when guests requested extra towels.

example_translations.ko_KR: 투숙객들이 수건을 추가로 요청하자 호텔 직원들은 기꺼이 응했습니다.

definition_translations.ja_JP: 誰かのために役立つことをする
